comment: wb-mgss roster (owner ruling R735 on the wb-agwj gate cmd_f48ab3750faf F3: ONE structural site-binding follow-up outside the spelling chain): the OUT-OF-FILE anchor of the wb-mgss site binding at the end of test/workbench-claude-message-ref.test.ts. requirement is what every bound row asserts of the reading it judges. sets are the bound row sets in run order: each set's title stem, the roster that lists its rows and the field that holds them (a list of rows, or one row). Every row of a bound set, at every site its roster row names, measures where its reading came from and asserts the requirement; the census compares each measurement, in run order, to the rows these rosters derive. requiredBoundRows is that count (rows times sites).
requirement: the reading a bound row judges came from the site its title names: that site's file, with exactly the text the row's own tabled placement makes of the site's real source, and from no other site
